facts.fact: EAAIF announced on 5 August 2026 a USD 50 million loan to refinance and maintain Liquid Intelligent Technologies' existing 110,000 km cross-border fibre network across 25 countries including Kenya, South Africa and Zimbabwe; the document does not name another country using it or a Kenyan link end, and gives no date for when the network entered service.
